vegeta.externalRequestLimitation: Every scenario reported only the Google Fonts CSS request blocked by the proxy (ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED). No application JavaScript exception or internal asset load failure.

notes: Base black-haired Vegeta uses the sleeveless blue training outfit of the local reference: white gloves and boots with gold toes, no chest armor, Majin mark, Super Saiyan hair or added weapon.

The core special-state montage is Galick Gun. An actual Final Flash action takes priority and uses the original dedicated presentation atlas row 7, with wide-arm preparation, forward two-handed yellow release and recovery.
After the production boot preload fix, every traced cold-page super draw uses the dedicated Final Flash row, including the first draw; the initial short core fallback is resolved.
The eight-grip image overlays four native frame draws at each side of one platform. Individual projected contact points are recorded in the trace.
Native artwork is an adaptation with minor perspective/anatomy/scale variation and DBZ dash-like running leg positions; official source-frame fidelity is not certified.

resolvedColdLoadFallback.diagnosis: The dedicated Final Flash row already existed and had rendering priority. The first cold-load frames could fall back to core special while the presentation PNG loaded. Core-only state sampling does not determine rendering priority for a real super action.
